art_direction: 一眼细长、一眼略饱满，黑瞳接上缘，纸面留形不规则，双眼侧望。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Draw two eyes with a worn broad felt marker. One opening is a long relaxed slash; the other is a slightly fuller hook. Both large black pupils merge into the upper marks and look sideways together. Reserve generous awkward paper gaps inside them, different but related. Add a small flat iris patch beside each pupil. Let the marker ends hesitate and taper without scattered noise. Keep the pair centered on paper. Eyes only, no brows or mouth.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
